comparison: Both address hypoxia characterization (C28-C29). OpenEval finds all regional characterization data (C28-C37) well-supported. Peer reviewers accept baseline hypoxia measurements (C28-C29) but express concerns about regional analysis in mutants (R2, R3).

OpenEval supports regional molecular signatures (C30-C33) as part of comprehensive characterization. Peer reviewers rate these as UNCERTAIN, requesting careful regional analysis in mutants to validate the hypoxia-dependent mechanism.

OpenEval supports proteasome inhibitor and immunostaining data (C34-C37). Peer reviewers rate as UNCERTAIN, requesting validation in genetic manipulation contexts as part of broader regional analysis concerns.

Both address Yap1/Taz mutant phenotypes in bone (C3, C39, C43-C47). OpenEval finds data strongly supported with appropriate controls. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN due to concerns about similar effects in both regions despite different hypoxia levels.

Both address retinal phenotype (C38, C55). OpenEval finds retinal data well-supported. Peer reviewers also support this, noting the contrasting bone versus retina effects contribute to the study's novelty and organ-specific insights.

Both evaluate Yap1-KI gain-of-function data (C40, C48-C49). OpenEval finds the opposite phenotype provides strong evidence. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, specifically requesting more detailed regional analysis of the YAP knock-in mice.

Both address Lats2 mutant phenotypes (C5, C41, C50-C54). OpenEval finds data well-supported with mechanistic insight. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, requesting detailed regional analysis due to concerns about similar effects in both regions.

Both evaluate organ-specificity of Lats2 effects (C6, C56). OpenEval and peer reviewers agree this data is SUPPORTED, with reviewers emphasizing the contribution to understanding organ-specific biological responses.

Both address RNA-seq gene expression patterns (C57-C61). OpenEval finds data strongly supported with appropriate statistics. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, requesting expansion to other HIF target genes beyond VEGFA.

Both evaluate gene expression in Lats2 and Yap1/Taz mutants (C62-C63). OpenEval supports the opposite patterns as compelling evidence. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, requesting more detailed regional and cell-type-specific gene expression analysis.

Both evaluate ChIP and epistasis data (C70-C71). OpenEval supports this as part of comprehensive mechanistic evidence. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, suggesting the approach is correct but needs expansion to more HIF target genes and molecular partners.

Both address genetic epistasis experiments (C73-C74). OpenEval finds HIF1α gain-of-function and double mutant data provide strong in vivo evidence. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, requesting further analysis of YAP1/TAZ signaling in HIF1α mutants.

Both evaluate angiogenesis-osteogenesis coupling (C75-C79). OpenEval finds the coupling clearly demonstrated. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, requesting further bone parameter data to enhance value for general audience.

Both address Yap1-KI osteogenic phenotype (C80-C81). OpenEval supports the opposite phenotype as additional evidence. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, requesting more bone parameters and regional detail for the YAP knock-in model.

Both evaluate double mutant rescue of osteogenic phenotype (C82). OpenEval finds genetic epistasis demonstrates HIF1α requirement. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, suggesting data support the model but need expansion as part of broader HIF1α mutant analysis.

Both address the central mechanistic model (C8, C95-C96). OpenEval rates UNCERTAIN, noting the model is consistent with observations but requires additional direct testing. Peer reviewers also rate UNCERTAIN, with multiple essential revisions challenging regional specificity, molecular interaction evidence, and pathway comprehensiveness.

Both address retinal phenotype (C55). OpenEval supports this as demonstrating organ-specific effects. Peer reviewers also support, noting contrasting bone versus retina effects contribute to novelty.
